content: Our model gets the M INLINEFORM0 score of 32.1. While it does not reach the score of the best CoNLL model BIBREF24 or the state-of-the-art BIBREF25 , these use annotated corpora to train. Our results count as restricted in CoNLL definitions and are more directly comparable to the classifier-based approach trained on unannotated corpora by BIBREF26 , while requiring even less effort.
